description: Your whole Garmin history in a local database, not one 28-day page at a time.

novel_features.name: Loopback browser login with identity assertion
novel_features.description: Signs in through Garmin's own page in your browser, catches the redirect on a loopback port, and refuses to store a token whose account email does not match the one you named.

novel_features.name: Windowed backfill of the 28-day-capped series
novel_features.description: Walks the date-ranged daily-stats series backwards into a local SQLite archive and resumes where it stopped — 28-day windows where Garmin caps a request at 28 days, 364-day windows where it does not, and one request per day for the per-day series.
